sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list shows vasopressin is not listed as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East holds 161 vials of the 1 mL presentation with 4.4 vials used per day, giving 36.7 days on hand.
Corvale General holds 185 vials with 6.3 vials used per day, giving 29.3 days on hand.
The rule ranks Dr. Reddy's Laboratories, Inc. as the first alternate manufacturer; its plant Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Limited-FTO-9 was last inspected VAI on 2024-05-17.
American Regent, Inc. is the second alternate with a plant last inspected VAI on 2026-06-18.
Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC is the third alternate but its label names no plant we could place.
The current label for the product in use names Medical Purchasing Solutions, LLC (FEI 3014288534), a registered repack plant last inspected VAI on 2024-09-11.
